# QA Checklist (Skill Asset)

## Facts
- [ ] No fabricated facts
- [ ] Story Time claims are source-backed
- [ ] Core facts have reliable sources
- [ ] Source URLs are included and readable

## Child Readability
- [ ] Short sentences
- [ ] Short paragraphs for read-aloud
- [ ] Story Time has a clear story arc
- [ ] Hard words explained

## Structure
- [ ] Story Time section present
- [ ] Required sections all present
- [ ] Memory Check section present
- [ ] Sources section present

## Bilingual Consistency
- [ ] EN and ZH files both updated
- [ ] Fact set matches between languages
- [ ] Section order matches

## Release Gate
- [ ] Files saved under data/en and data/zh
- [ ] Line ID naming matches project convention
- [ ] Ready to publish
